responses.title: Why your AI should live in your office
responses.subtitle: A practical case for local models in small firms
responses.hook: Most small teams send client files to a cloud AI without thinking about where that data ends up.
responses.body:
## The case

Local AI agents keep proprietary data on the machine. A 9B-parameter model now runs on a consumer GPU with 12 GB of VRAM.

## What to run first

Routine drafting and ticket summaries, which avoid per-token cloud fees when they run locally.

## What to keep in the cloud

Long, multi-step reasoning, where frontier models still lead.
responses.cta: Follow for the full local-AI checklist series
